title: TCP: Set base sequence, relative sequence numbers for IP fragments
description:
There's no reason not to do this for fragmented packets, so long
as we got enough of the TCP header to get the SEQ and ACK numbers.

Pass in the rawseq and rawack to tcp_analyze_sequence_number, since
it was being called immediately before setting the relative sequence
number.

Fix #13550
